has unveiled the 2027 Rogue Hybrid, adding an electrified variant to its best-selling U.S. crossover lineup. The updated model features new-in-class hybrid technology designed to boost power, fuel efficiency, and overall performance.
"Hybrids are increasingly becoming the powertrain of choice for U.S. customers, and we believe that trend will only accelerate," said Christian Meunier, chairman, Nissan Americas.

“We’re now maxing out the production capacity in the U.S.,” Christian Meunier, chairman of Nissan Americas, told CNBC. “The next step is going to be three shifts, and I’m pretty optimistic that with the launch of the new Rogue that is happening in the next couple months, we’ll be able to do that pretty quickly with the launch of the hybrid.”

The all-new 2027 Rogue Hybrid goes on sale in fall 2026. The full model range (SV, SR and Platinum) is available in early 2027 with Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Prices (MSRP) starting at $35,4902 for the SV grade.

title: Nissan unveils 2027 Rogue Hybrid, eyes U.S. production increase
